method: document.documentElement.scrollWidth - window.innerWidth after setViewportSize; plus getBoundingClientRect().right for visible elements
note: Page scrollWidth did not exceed innerWidth. clientWidth is smaller than innerWidth by the scrollbar (~15px). That is not page overflow. The review table (.history-table) is wider than the mobile viewport (~413px) and sits in .history-table-wrap { overflow-x: auto }. Detected type / Debit-Credit columns require horizontal scroll at 320–414.
